title: Root isolation for analytic functions using cubic hermite interpolation
summary: We present a root isolation algorithm for an analytic function. The method combines interval subdivision with a heuristic test based on local cubic Hermite interpolation. Whenever the function is sufficiently close to its cubic Hermite interpolant at a few sample points, we assume that the critical points of the cubic interpolant give a valid root isolation for the original function. Such an algorithm cannot, in general, provide a rigorous certification of the computed intervals.
